name: Murasaki Anji
source: A musician who is active in the Z district and the vocalist of the band 'Colchicum'. Despite being an amateur band, Colchicum recently made their major debut. Arrogant, forcible and sometimes a bit uninterested. He has a snobbish and luxurious atmosphere which is unusual for the Z district. A very prideful person.
